full_name: Sophie Hochhäusl | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Frieda L. Miller Fellow University of Pennsylvania
bio: Sophie Hochhäusl is an architect and architectural historian whose scholarly work centers on modern architecture and urban culture in Austria, Germany, and the United States with a focus on environmental history, women and gender studies, and the history of social movements. Her most recent work engages questions of housing, health, and food production in the city, wartime resource scarcities, and the work of urban cooperative movements, including women’s associations.
